question: How long does my passport need to be valid after I leave Vietnam?
expected_answer: The archived guidance requires six months of passport validity after the planned exit from Vietnam.
expected_context:
# exotravel vietnam visa information

VIETNAM – TOURIST VISA REQUIREMENTS

Most tourists visiting Vietnam require a Tourist Visa to enter the country and all travelers must have a
passport valid for 6 months after their planned exit from Vietnam. EXO Travel can assist and facilitate
applications for Tourist visas; for other types of visas, please consult the official representatives of
Vietnam (Embassy or Consulate) abroad.

COUNTRIES EXEMPT
notes: Corpus-grounded; archived travel/visa claims are not current-policy guidance.

question: I have a single-entry visa for Vietnam. Can I visit Cambodia for a few days and then come back on the same visa?
expected_answer: The archived guidance says a single-entry visa cannot be reused after leaving Vietnam: a new visa is needed to re-enter, or a multiple-entry visa must be specifically applied for.
expected_context:
TYPES OF TOURIST VISAS AND VALIDITY

A tourist visa is normally a Single Entry Visa, which means that if you exit Vietnam (for example for a
side trip to Cambodia); you will require a new visa to re-enter.

There is also a Multiple-Entry Visa which has to be specifically applied for.

The Single entry visa is valid for 30 days.

The Multiple entry visa is valid either 28 or 45 days (see details below)

HOW TO OBTAIN A TOURIST VISA

Case 1: Visa application in your country before departure
notes: Corpus-grounded; archived travel/visa claims are not current-policy guidance.

question: My passport expires in five months. Could I be turned away when I arrive in Vietnam?
expected_answer: The archived visitor notes say entry may be refused with less than six months of passport validity.
expected_context:
Travel Advice

Please note that entry to Vietnam may be refused if your passport has less than
six months validity.
notes: Corpus-grounded; archived travel/visa claims are not current-policy guidance.

question: What happens if I stay in Vietnam after my visa expires?
expected_answer: The archived visitor notes mention fines and/or imprisonment for overstaying a visa.
expected_context:
Visitors from visa countries, or whose visits are longer than 15 days, or who
require more than one entry into Vietnam, or are returning to Vietnam within less
than three months from their previous visit must obtain a visa. Visas are usually
valid for one month. You should check the visa validity and conditions
carefully. There are fines and/or imprisonment if you overstay your visa.

For further information, check with your nearest Vietnamese Embassy.
notes: Corpus-grounded; archived travel/visa claims are not current-policy guidance.

question: Why is Independence Palace historically important?
expected_answer: It was the presidential home and workplace during the Republic of Vietnam era. Tanks crashed through its gates on April 30, 1975, marking the end of the Vietnam War.
expected_context: The Independence Palace, also known as the Reunification Palace, is one of the most iconic historical landmarks in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Built on the site of the former Norodom Palace, it served as the presidential home and workplace during the Republic of Vietnam era. Most notably, it marked the end of the Vietnam War when tanks crashed through its gates on April 30, 1975.
